context.hint: Apply environment-specific browser origin defaults and preserve explicit settings.
context.surface: A browser dashboard calls an API with environment-specific CORS configuration.
assumptions: Use synthetic origins and an in-process API client.

review.invariant: The default development policy grants browser access only to the intended dashboard origins.
review.verification: Check preflight requests from an approved dashboard origin and a synthetic origin outside the allowlist. Assert that only the approved origin receives an allow-origin header.

source_observation.summary: The ASGI regression failed on the original policy and passed after the change. A real browser was outside the check.
